scope: canonical admission of the independently qualified restricted serialized DIVDRA active runtime callsite

invariants.note: Uses the same canonical SWAP kernel and serialized physical runtime; no separate drainage kernel.
Candidate runtime composition contains no file/path/parser I/O.
Distribution parameters, hydraulic views, scalar transfer, committed state, numerical config and results remain separate typed inputs/outputs.
No new persistent drainage state; immutable distribution parameters are registry-referenced.
Temporary distribution rows/probes are runtime-local composition scratch, not per-column persistent state.
No per-column heavy solver allocation is introduced; feature-active work is scoped to requested columns.
Complete DIVDRA preflight occurs before generic runtime checkpoint/solver execution; rejected composition cannot mutate committed state.
No restriction is added to recomputation or warm-start policy; physical inputs remain explicit.
Entry point forwards generic t0,t1 and introduces no daily/calendar semantics.
No coupling-window duration is assumed.
No coupling capability is removed or hidden; explicit hydraulic-view provenance is preserved.
No groundwater interface sign/head contract is changed; groundwater level is read only from explicit hydraulic views.
Drainage enters the existing source/sink mass ledger exactly once; independent hard-mass checks pass.
No interface-sensitivity API is suppressed; this workunit does not claim drainage tangents.
No extra full SWAP solves are introduced by the binding.
Serialized active callsite is intentionally restricted; two-column isolation is independently verified and parallel DIVDRA remains unclaimed.
No MODFLOW-cell or tile mapping is introduced into SWAP runtime code.
No deep-vadose logic is embedded.
No component-transition storage is created or discarded.
Composition remains above the common soil-water runtime; no Richards implementation is hard-wired by the new API.
Reuses admitted SWAP drainage distribution and existing process/source-sink physics.
No HeadCalc internals are accessed; hydraulic information is supplied through process_hydraulic_view_t.
Physical DIVDRA requests are separate from canonical_numerical_config_t; no performance policy changes physics.
No unbounded retry/solver policy is added; fail-closed preflight is bounded.
Reference/full-accuracy path is unchanged and reference tree is bit-identical.
Typed composition status and per-active-column binding diagnostics are returned; existing runtime diagnostics remain available.
Inactive columns perform no DIVDRA materialization; optional work scales with use.
Runtime composition owns registry/reference relationships; SWAP process provider knows no tile/MODFLOW composition.
No midnight, one-day, file-format or MODFLOW dependency is introduced.
F-MR36 owner qualification, F-VQ51 independent qualification and this explicit admission audit cover the architecture change.
